Manage EDR agents and dispatch remote actions.

Commands connect to a running Trace server to list agents, view telemetry,
and send response actions to deployed endpoint agents.

Requires --server or TRACE_SERVER_URL env var and --api-key or TRACE_API_KEY.

Subcommands:
  list          List all registered EDR agents
  view          View agent details and status
  events        View recent events from an agent
  dispatch      Send a response action to an agent (kill, quarantine, block, etc.)
  dismiss       Mark an alert as false positive (trains the FP learning model)
  revoke        Remove an agent from the server

Usage:
  trace edr [command]

Available Commands:
  dismiss     Mark an alert as false positive (trains FP learning)
  dispatch    Send a response action to an agent
  events      View recent events from an agent
  list        List all registered EDR agents
  revoke      Revoke and remove an agent from the server
  view        View agent details and status
  vuln        Query agent vulnerabilities

Flags:
      --api-key string   API key for server authentication
  -h, --help             help for edr
      --server string    Trace server URL (default: http://localhost:8080)

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file

Use "trace edr [command] --help" for more information about a command.
